title: wedelia retroflexa
intro: Wedelia retroflexa, commonly known as Sow Thistle or Billygoat weed, is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Asia and Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Wedelia retroflexa include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing fever, treating respiratory issues, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
